svg.title: SatsunicGo AI
svg.text: Only allowed tools · recheck access on every call
Writes on one order: in order
Loop until there is a final answer
One tool fails → keep other results
Logs each call: tokens, cost, latency
Grouped by area · load only what the task needs
Check owner / role · record each write
Keep what the next turn needs; order state stays outside the prompt
Memory cannot grant access or prove payment
Runs separately from chat and payments · use only permitted data
